content: [Feishu Carol Fri Mar 07 11:00 EST 2026] For every JSON deliverable, please stamp a top-level `schema_version` field = "1.0". Our lakehouse registry keys artefacts by it and rejects untagged files at load time.
Confirmed: every output JSON will carry a top-level schema_version field set to "1.0". This matches house preference P1.
[Feishu Carol Fri Mar 07 11:05 EST 2026] And the pivot must be keyed by payment_type code then borough, using the official payment_type enumeration, not free-text labels.
Understood: pivot keyed payment_type (codes 1–6) → Borough, using the official enumeration from the data dictionary.
